atomicRpc.mechanism: One HTTP/JSON-RPC response; frozen projected object bound in the owning client WeakMap to the requested hash; cloned/mixed/foreign observations rejected.
atomicRpc.nodeIdentity: Logical response context, not physical node attestation. No stable physical node ID is exposed by this RPC method.
atomicRpc.network: getNetwork verifies Testnet before lookup; no fallback endpoint; redirects denied

signer.mechanism: deferredSigning factory inside application composition; dynamic import/constructor only for authorize/signEnvelope after transport guards; public-only verification.

historical.guard: Before idempotency cache, in queue, and service prepare/process before worker/simulation.
historical.ui: UI unchanged; exact mutation routes used by UI reject. No successful API action path; not a contract-level ban.
historical.tombstoneReadIndependently: PRESENT; common Git metadata read with approved process permissions, no write.

scope.transport: CHANGED: raw guard and coherent NOT_FOUND validation
scope.sql: Schema and SQL files unchanged; application SELECT/JSON observation logic changed
